name: Kiro
description: Turns prompts into specs, designs, and task lists, then implements them for developers in Kiro's agentic IDE or CLI, including headless CI runs.

skills.name: Spec-Driven Development
skills.description: Generates requirements.md, design.md, and tasks.md for a feature or bugfix, then tracks implementation task by task.

skills.name: Parallel Task Execution
skills.description: Builds a dependency graph of spec tasks and runs independent tasks concurrently in waves.

skills.name: Headless Mode
skills.description: Runs prompts non-interactively in CI/CD pipelines with an API key and emits JSON Lines events for scripts.

skills.name: Agent Client Protocol
skills.description: Exposes the Kiro CLI over ACP for programmatic agent interactions from editors and other tools.

skills.name: Agent Hooks
skills.description: Automates actions before and after commands and tool calls, including PreToolUse hooks that can deny a call.
